text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 1: quantile score against lead, farms A to F pooled, daylight, runs from 2025-09 to 2026-08, quarterly refits. Lower is better. The arms share the same rows, so the intervals of their differences (Figure 2) are far narrower than the spread between months.'
text.tspan: Figure 1: quantile score against lead, farms A to F pooled, daylight, runs from 2025-09 to 2026-08, quarterly
Lower is better. The arms share the same rows, so the intervals of their differences (Figure 2) are far
narrower than the spread between months.
